summary: Carlyle Private Equity Partners Fund, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of limited partnership units under its continuous private offering. Sales on August 1, 2026 totaled approximately $13.4 million across four classes (E-A, E-I, I, C), with prices based on July 31, 2026 transactional NAV. The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no tender, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. Watch for ongoing monthly NAV-based issuances.
